# Online Compass

> > A collection of free, browser-based measurement and navigation tools that leverage device sensors for real-time orientation, speed, light, and magnetic field detection.

Online Compass provides a suite of web-based instruments for navigation and measurement without requiring app installation. The platform supports multiple languages and uses device sensors including GPS, accelerometers, and magnetometers to deliver accurate real-time measurements.

## Key Topics

- online compass
- navigation tool
- browser-based
- device sensors
- cardinal directions
- GPS measurement

## Core Navigation & Measurement Tools

- [Online Compass](https://onlinecompass.app): Browser-based compass showing direction relative to geographic cardinal directions north, south, east, and west
- [Spirit Level](https://onlinecompass.app/spirit-level): Online spirit level tool for measuring whether surfaces are horizontal (level) or vertical (plumb)
- [Inclinometer](https://onlinecompass.app/inclinometer): Online inclinometer for measuring slope, elevation, and tilt angles using device sensors
- [Speedometer](https://onlinecompass.app/speedometer): Online speedometer measuring real-time vehicle speed in km/h and MPH via GPS without app installation
- [Light Meter](https://onlinecompass.app/light-meter): Online light meter measuring illuminance in LUX and footcandles using phone light sensor
- [Magnetometer](https://onlinecompass.app/magnetometer): Online magnetometer measuring magnetic field strength and EMF at specific locations

## International Language Versions

- [Indonesian (Kompas Online)](https://onlinecompass.app/id): Indonesian version of OnlineCompass for navigation using geographic cardinal directions
- [Malay (Kompas Dalam Talian)](https://onlinecompass.app/ms): Malay version of OnlineCompass for navigation and orientation with cardinal directions
- [German (Online-Kompass)](https://onlinecompass.app/de): German version of OnlineCompass for navigation and orientation with cardinal directions
- [Spanish (Brújula en línea)](https://onlinecompass.app/es): Spanish version of OnlineCompass for navigation using geographic cardinal directions
- [French (Compas en ligne)](https://onlinecompass.app/fr): French version of OnlineCompass for navigation and orientation with cardinal directions
- [Italian (Bussola in linea)](https://onlinecompass.app/it): Italian version of OnlineCompass for navigation using geographic cardinal directions
- [Dutch (Online kompas)](https://onlinecompass.app/nl): Dutch version of OnlineCompass for navigation and orientation with cardinal directions
- [Danish (Online kompas)](https://onlinecompass.app/da): Danish version of OnlineCompass for navigation using geographic cardinal directions
- [Norwegian (Nettkompass)](https://onlinecompass.app/nb): Norwegian version of OnlineCompass for navigation using geographic cardinal directions
- [Polish (Kompas online)](https://onlinecompass.app/pl): Polish version of OnlineCompass for navigation and orientation with cardinal directions
- [Portuguese (Bússola online)](https://onlinecompass.app/pt): Portuguese version of OnlineCompass for navigation using geographic cardinal directions
